description: Monorepo containing Minecraft Bedrock add-ons, maps, scripts, and minigames for CurseForge and MCPEDL by ALNStudios.
rules: Instructions and standards are centralized in INSTRUCTIONS.md, PACK_GENERATOR_INSTRUCTIONS.md, and DOCS_RULES.md; query via Context7 rather than inlining into review files.
Always follow DOCS_RULES.md: player-facing text only, display names (e.g. 'Diamond'), no code identifiers or raw file/module paths in descriptions.
Do not hand-edit generated files: MCPEDL/README.md, Package/*.listing.md, changelog_views/*, builds/README.md.
All packaging and catalog synchronization must use scripts/auto_bump_and_build.py.
Version formats follow 3-part semantic versioning (Vmajor.minor.patch) for packs.
Keep old build snapshots pruned: retain at least 1 current and 1 old version snapshot per project.
